Rationale.DE1_ResultFidelity: The replicated documentation reports payload experiment results (IIA=1.0 at layers 26-30, 81%+ of model depth) that are proportionally consistent with the original findings (IIA near-perfect after layer 56, 70%+ of 80-layer model). Model accuracy differences (10% vs 34.9% baseline) are attributable to smaller sample size (20 vs 1000) and documented as expected limitations of the smaller 8B model. Pointer experiment limitations are transparently reported.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: The replication conclusions align with the original paper: both confirm payload information is encoded in later layers, the interchange intervention methodology is reproducible, and the general pattern holds across model sizes. The replication appropriately limits its claims to what was successfully validated and does not overclaim.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: All information in the replicated documentation was verified against original repository files. Dataset counts (103 characters, 21 containers, 23 drinks) match synthetic_entities/*.json. Paper citations, methodology descriptions, and original findings all trace to CodeWalkthrough.md and plan.md. Replication-specific results are derived from actual experiments in replication_results.json.
